segments.t: The restaurant owner calls the Chef to his table and tells him that he is now very famous. They talk about the video on the internet, which has many views. The Chef is very surprised by this news.

'I expect a tasty lunch today.' Nagiyev chooses the imperfective verb meaning 'I'm waiting' for the ongoing action, followed by 'delicious' and 'lunch'.

'It will be done, my boss.' Chef Barinov chooses the imperfective verb meaning 'will be' for the ongoing action, followed by 'made' and 'boss'. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.

The Chef is very happy that he is not fired. He goes back to the kitchen to cook food for all the new guests. Next time you watch the episode, listen for the Russian expressions for 'to have a look' and 'video' — you will catch every word right away. See you in the next scene.
